title: feat(app-shell): the designer registries are observable, and their readers re-render on registration (objectui#11939 step 1)
body:
Refs #11939 (step 1)

Clause-②: yes

Step 1 of objectui#6795's order, as ruled on objectui#11942 (item C, comment 6056819248): the three metadata designer registries become observable, and every reader that reads them during render moves onto the observable read. Step 2 (lazy loading, moving registration off the package root, the `sideEffects` array, the eager ceiling) is not in this PR and stays on #11939.

## What changes

**One store under the three registries.** `preview-registry.ts`, `inspector-registry.ts` and `default-inspector-registry.ts` each kept a module-level `Map`. Each now keeps it in one store, `createObservableTypeRegistry` (defined in `preview-registry.ts`, module-internal, not re-exported from the package entry). The store is the same `Map` plus a set of listeners:

- a registration that changes an entry notifies every listener;
- registering a type again with the component it already holds changes nothing a reader can see, and notifies no one;
- React reads it through `useSyncExternalStore`. The per-type snapshot is the stored component itself. The type-list snapshot is a frozen, sorted array, built once per change of the type SET and reused until the next one. A list read that builds a new array per call is the uncached-snapshot loop the brief warned about.
- The server snapshot is the same read: registration is module state, so a server render sees whatever its module graph registered.

## The widening, export by export

New on the package entry (`packages/app-shell/src/index.ts`, in the two existing registry re-export statements):

- `useRegisteredMetadataPreview(type: string): MetadataPreview | undefined`
- `useRegisteredMetadataPreviewTypes(): readonly string[]` (frozen, sorted, the same array until a new type is registered)
- `useRegisteredMetadataInspector(type: string): MetadataInspector | undefined`

Read off the built entry, `packages/app-shell/dist/index.d.ts`: the two registry re-export lines now carry these three names in addition to the six they carried. No other line of the entry moved.

New in the registry modules, NOT reachable from the package entry (the package's `exports` map has only `.`):

- `useRegisteredMetadataInspectorTypes(): readonly string[]` and `useRegisteredMetadataDefaultInspector(type: string): MetadataDefaultInspector | undefined`. Their readers are all inside the package. The default-inspector registry was not on the entry before this PR either.
- `createObservableTypeRegistry` and its interface `ObservableTypeRegistry`, generic over the stored value (written here without the angle-bracket spelling, which GitHub strips).

Why exactly these, by the four axes:

- **Business need, measured.** Each of the three entry exports has an out-of-package reader in this PR: `apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx` reads all three. The other two hooks have readers only inside the package, so they stay off the entry.
- **No `subscribe` export, although the claim names one.** No reader needs it: every render read goes through a hook. A raw `subscribe` also invites a hand-rolled `useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, listMetadataPreviewTypes)`, which hands React a new array on every call and loops. The hook is the read that cannot be written that way. The claim's declared widening is narrowed here, not exceeded.
- **Naming.** The brief's example name `useMetadataInspector` already exists in this package: it is the debug-panel hook in `views/MetadataInspector.tsx`, imported by `ObjectView`, `PageView` and `DashboardView` and mocked by name in several suites. A second hook with that name and another meaning is the kind of trap the third axis is about. Hence `useRegistered*`.

## The existing contract, unchanged for current callers

Before and after, for each existing declaration:

- `registerMetadataPreview(type: string, component: MetadataPreview): void`, `registerMetadataInspector` and `registerMetadataDefaultInspector`, with the same two-parameter signature. Before: `Map.set`. After: the same signature, the store's `set`, which is `Map.set` plus the notification. Overwrite semantics are unchanged.
- `getMetadataPreview(type: string): MetadataPreview | undefined`, with `getMetadataInspector` and `getMetadataDefaultInspector` alike. Before: `Map.get`. After: the same signature, the store's `get`, which is `Map.get`.
- `listMetadataPreviewTypes(): string[]` and `listMetadataInspectorTypes(): string[]`. Before: a new sorted array per call. After: the same, a new sorted array per call. They do NOT hand out the cached hook snapshot, so a caller that mutates the result changes nothing.

How that is shown:

- `git diff` of the three registry modules against the base removes no `export` line. Every existing export keeps its parameter list and return type. The ten removed lines are the three `Map` declarations, the two `list*` bodies, three import lines (now importing the store too) and two doc-comment lines.
- `observableRegistries-11939.test.tsx`, "the register / get / list contract is unchanged for current callers": overwrite, lookup, sort order, and a fresh caller-owned array per `list*` call, for all three registries.
- Every existing suite of the migrated readers passes with its assertions untouched (counts below). The four existing test files this PR edits changed in header comments only.
- The one new behaviour a current caller can observe: a component that renders through these registries now re-renders when its entry is registered or replaced after its first render.

## Read sites

Measured on `main` with `git grep` over `getMetadataPreview`, `listMetadataPreviewTypes`, `getMetadataInspector`, `listMetadataInspectorTypes` and `getMetadataDefaultInspector`, outside tests, across the whole repository (every package, app and example). The result matches the seat's list; no reader was missed. `registry.ts` does not front these three: it is the separate `MetadataResource` registry, and nothing in it reads them.

- **`ResourceEditPage`: canvas preview, scoped inspector, default inspector.** Now the three hooks, called once near the top of the component, above the auto-design effect and the `loading` early return (hooks may not follow an early return). The old read sites use those values.
- **`ResourceEditPage`: the auto-design effect.** It read `getMetadataPreview(type)` inside the effect. It now reads the observed preview and lists it in the effect's dependencies, so a canvas registered late switches the open editor into design mode exactly as a canvas registered before the first render does. With the registry populated the value never changes, so the effect runs exactly as before.
- **`ResourceEditPage`: `doSave` and `doReset`. Kept as plain `getMetadataPreview(type)` calls.** Both run in event handlers and read the registry at the moment of the click, which is already current.
- **`EmbeddedItemEditor`: the sub-type's preview.** `useRegisteredMetadataPreview(editAs ?? '')`, then `editAs ? registered : undefined`, as before.
- **`ObjectSettingsPanel`, `ObjectHooksPanel`, `ObjectActionsPanel`: the default inspector for `object`, `hook`, `action`.** `useRegisteredMetadataDefaultInspector`.
- **`StudioDesignSurface`, Interfaces pillar: preview, inspector, default inspector, and the designers-missing check.** The hooks. Both type lists are read unconditionally, because a hook behind `&&` would be a conditional hook.
- **`StudioDesignSurface`, Data pillar field rail: the object inspector.** `useRegisteredMetadataInspector('object')`.
- **`StudioDesignSurface`, Automations pillar: flow preview, flow inspector, designers-missing check.** As in Interfaces.
- **`apps/console/src/preview-gallery.tsx`: preview, inspector, preview types.** The three entry hooks. The inspector read moved above the card's early return.

The comments beside these reads that said "no change notification … never recovers" are made false by this PR, so they were rewritten:

- `ObjectActionsPanel`'s fallback pane;
- the Data pillar's field-rail fallback;
- the Interfaces and Automations designers-missing notes;
- four test headers: `StudioDesignSurface.designerRegistryMissing`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.designerRegistryMissing`, `ObjectActionsPanel.designerRegistryMissing` and `StudioDesignSurface.studioCanvasLeaf`.

Their wording rule ("no loading…, no try again") stands, with its new reason: nothing on those surfaces knows a registration is on its way. No user-facing string changed.

In `index.ts`, the comment "These 25 runtime re-exports name the LEAF modules" lost its number, because this PR adds three. Per AGENTS.md #9 it now states the rule without a count.

## Recovery pins: objectui#6795's probe, repeated

Each pin shows today's fallback, registers inside `act`, and requires the designer to render, with no remount and no navigation (objectui#6795 measured "late inspector rendered: false"; each pin reads "true"):

- `StudioDesignSurface.lateRegistration-11939.test.tsx`: the Data pillar field rail (object inspector), the Interfaces canvas (page preview), and the Automations canvas (flow preview; the header chip stops naming a missing designer).
- `ObjectPanels.lateRegistration-11939.test.tsx`: the Settings, Actions and Hooks panels.
- `ResourceEditPage.lateRegistration-11939.test.tsx`: the canvas, design mode, the default inspector and the scoped inspector.

Controls:

- In every pin, a registration for ANOTHER type first, which leaves the fallback in place.
- In `observableRegistries-11939.test.tsx`: an already-populated registry renders its reader once (React `Profiler` commit count 1), and neither a same-component re-registration nor another type's registration renders it again. The type snapshot is the same array between renders and changes only with the type set. React logs no uncached-snapshot or update-depth error.
- Each pin file owns its types and asserts them unregistered first, so the files are order-independent although the registries are module state shared by a file.

## Reverse verification

Run through `ablation-replace` on the committed `7d6b48d1`. Each leg ran the 22 tests of the four new files.

- **Leg 1: the store's `set` stops notifying** (its listener loop replaced). Predicted 15 red and 7 green. Measured 15 failed and 7 passed; every reader pin failed at its post-registration assertion, after its before-state and control had held.
- **Leg 2: `ResourceEditPage` reads the canvas through `getMetadataPreview(type)` again.** Predicted: only the ResourceEditPage pin red. Measured 1 failed and 21 passed, failing at `findByTestId('late-canvas')`.

Both restores were proven by the tool (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tests import the readers by relative path and vitest aliases workspace packages to `src`, so no `dist` sat between a mutation and its reading.

## First-load bytes

The console `vite build` aliases workspace packages to `src`, so both sides were built in one tree with only this PR's 11 changed source files swapped, and restored afterwards (11 blobs equal to HEAD):

- against `main` `70e3d772`: eager closure 3,386,321 to 3,386,505 gzip bytes (**+184**), raw +455, chunk count 336 to 336. The bytes are the store code in the `default-inspector-registry` chunk (+192 gzip); the rest is gzip noise of a few bytes in two chunks.
- `check:eager-closure`'s own verdict on this PR's build: "Console eager closure is 3307.1 KB gzipped across 336 of 2458 chunks (budget: 3312.0 KB, headroom: 4.9 KB)". On `main`'s: "3307.0 KB … (headroom: 5.0 KB)". The budget script was not touched.

## Tests and gates

Each reading names the head it was taken on.

- `pnpm exec vitest run` on `2bda96a2` (this branch with `main` `70e3d772` merged), over the whole `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/` directory, `ResourceEditPage*`, `EmbeddedItemEditor*`, `metadata-admin/__tests__/`, `PicklistPreview`, `page-schema`, `anchors.validation-retired`, and the four console suites that read these registries: **175 files, 1091 tests passed**.
- After `main` moved again (`247f5034`, four commits, none touching a file this PR touches) and was merged: the four new test files, **22 tests passed**, on `6a5094b9`, the head this PR opens at.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; the four new test files are in the test program, counted with `--listFilesOnly`) and `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0 on `2bda96a2` and again on `6a5094b9`, each after the dependency closure was rebuilt. The console check reads `@object-ui/app-shell` through its built `dist`; `preview-gallery.tsx` imports the three new names, so a stale declaration would have failed it.
- `pnpm exec eslint` on the 19 touched TypeScript files, on `6a5094b9`: 0 errors. Every modified source file has the same warning count as on `main`, and the new test files have none. Repo-wide lint is CI's: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so this diff cannot change a verdict on an untouched file.
- Exit 0 with a passing verdict on `2bda96a2` and again on `6a5094b9`: `check:control-bytes`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:side-effects-array`, `check:readme-exports`, and `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`. No locale pack changed, so the i18n family does not apply.
- Not run locally, and CI's: the rest of `@object-ui/app-shell`'s suites outside the directories above, and the full `pnpm test`.

Changeset: `.changeset/11939-observable-designer-registries.md`, `minor` on `@object-ui/app-shell` (the widening) and `patch` on `@object-ui/console` (the dev-only gallery's reads).

## Acceptance notes

Out of scope and not changed here, each outside this claim's file surface or outside its read sites:

- Two comments still say these registries have no change notification. One is in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/i18n.ts`, in the block above `engine.studio.if.designersMissing`. The other is in `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`'s Interfaces pillar, in the studio-canvas branch ("these registries are plain `Map`s read during render with no subscription"). Each is a one-sentence edit for whoever next touches the file; step 2's claim is the natural carrier.
- `scripts/vite-declared-lazy-views.ts` says "the package barrel's 25 runtime re-exports now name the LEAF modules". With this PR the count is 28. The rule it states still holds: all three new re-exports name leaf modules.
- The file headers of `ObjectActionsPanel.tsx`, `ObjectSettingsPanel.tsx` and `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` name `getMetadataDefaultInspector` / `getMetadataPreview` as where their editors come from. That is still the right registry, now read through its hook.
